Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Masterand student (d/f/m), title of thesis: Virtual Sensor & State Estimation Development for Fuel Cell Systems

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know about the development of virtual sensors and advanced state estimation techniques for fuel cell systems? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the ZEROe team as Masterand (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.11.2026

Your location

- Conduct a comprehensive literature review on virtual sensing, state estimation, and model-based diagnostics for fuel cell systems.

jobs.occupation: PhD position in SRF cavity control for gravitational wave searches (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

PhD position in SRF cavity control for gravitational wave searches

Remuneration Group 13 | Limited: 3 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: FHDO008/2026 | Deadline: open until filled | Full-time/Part-time

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

In the MAGO project we will develop the detection and control of RF fields of a superconducting cavity to be used to search for high-frequency gravitational waves. This interdisciplinary project is carried out together in our particle physics group and the group which is responsible for the controls, feedback regulations and synchronization of the particle accelerators at DESY.

About your role:

- Further development of high-precision RF field control of superconducting radio frequency (SRF) cavities used in gravitational wave search experiments.
- Further development of carrier suppression interferometer (CSI)-based techniques and their integration into the low-level RF (LLRF) system
- Development, production, test and operation of state-of-the-art RF measurement devices, to be installed at our cavity test stands
- Development of algorithms to assess and automate the calibration of the RF control and measurement system
- Performing measurement studies using the developed system on SRF cavities with a very high quality-factor

About you:

- MSc. degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent qualification
- Experience in RF design and measurements is beneficial
- Familiar with the theory of SRF cavities, interest in particle physics experiments
- Computer science skills e. g. Linux, Python, Matlab (competence in firmware and software is a plus)
- Strong motivation and pragmatism towards problem solving, teamwork as well as highly proficient English skills

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50 %). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV‑AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, increasing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our team  of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

Location/Division Specific Information

We are a research, development, and production site in Bremen currently, with about 500 employees, whose “high-end” measurement and analysis instruments (mass spectrometers) are used in research and science worldwide. Our innovative products in the fields of Life Sciences MS and Inorganic MS, as well as T  Elemental Analysis, are among the leading products globally in their respective markets.

The Scientific Software & Research Platform Engineer combines scientific investigation, data science, software engineering, and deep instrument knowledge to improve instrument performance, calibration, diagnostics, and reliability. This on-site role requires regular hands-on work with spectrometers, including prototypes, and close collaboration with Research, Production/Operations, and Support.

A day in the Life:

- Design, execute, and validate experiments using instrument, multi-sensor, and multi-modal data.
- Develop and evaluate algorithms for diagnostic and failure-mode modeling.
- Turn exploratory analyses and prototypes into reusable, well-tested research tools and reproducible experiment frameworks.
- Manage data versioning, metadata, experiment tracking, and scalable execution from laptops to servers/clusters.
- Build safe programmatic interfaces to instrument control software, firmware, and test stands, including autonomous agentic workflows.
- Package, install, and validate new iterations in lab and production test environments.
- Collaborate with researchers, Production Engineering, IT/Operations, and Support to ensure reliable and traceable deployment.
- The impact of this role is both scientific and technical: turning observations into trusted, reproducible diagnostic insights while building tools and knowledge that can be reused across instruments and teams.

Keys to Success:

Education

- Background in physics, applied mathematics, or a related quantitative/scientific field, with a strong track record of independent research and quantitative modeling

Experience

- Hands-on scientific investigation, experimental design, and analysis of complex real-world instrument or experimental data.
- Experience developing research software and translating scientific insights into diagnostic, predictive, or decision-support tools.
- Comfortable working directly with physical instruments and deploying and validating software in controlled lab or production test environments.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Scientific Software Engineering: Python, clean APIs, modular design, testing, and reproducible research workflows.
- Data & Modeling: Data analysis and visualization, SQL/NoSQL and file-based data systems, diagnostic modeling, experiment tracking, and model/version management.
- Engineering Tools: Strong Linux/Bash; CI, containerization, and server/cluster execution. Familiarity with C++/Rust is a plus.
- Production-aware delivery: Ability to install, configure, troubleshoot, and validate research software and translate manual processes into Documented and increasingly automated workflows.
- English: Full professional proficiency, written and spoken.

What we offer:

- Employment with an innovative, future-oriented organization
- Outstanding career and development prospects
- Company pension scheme and other fringe benefits
- Exciting company culture which stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation

Join us in shaping the future of our industry and make a significant impact through your expertise and leadership by applying online with your CV and Motivation Letter including possible start date and salary expectations.

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, each one of our 100,000 extraordinary minds has a unique story to tell. Join us and contribute to our singular mission—enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

jobs.occupation: Managing Consultant Global IT Vendor Management (m/f/d) (Global-Sourcing-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Introduction/About us

Group IT Strategy, Sourcing & Transformation shapes and supports the execution of the One IT vision across Fresenius. The department brings together IT procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor management, enterprise architecture, IT governance and service management to strengthen collaboration, ensure compliance and harmonize IT processes across the Group.

We are looking for an experienced Managing Consultant for Global IT Vendor Management (m/f/d) to lead the strategy, governance, commercial performance and executive relationships for selected strategic IT vendors. In this role, you will help protect contractual value, improve supplier performance, coordinate commercial and third-party risks, and ensure that strategic vendor relationships deliver measurable and sustainable business outcomes.

Your responsibilities

- Vendor strategy: Develop and maintain short- and long-term strategies for assigned strategic IT vendors, with measurable objectives covering cost optimization, service performance, technology adoption, innovation, contractual protection, flexibility and overall value.
- Contract lifecycle: Coordinate contractual obligations, commercial milestones, amendments, change orders, renewals, termination planning and exit readiness. Maintain a forward-looking renewal pipeline and ensure that contractual decisions receive the approvals and signatures required under applicable company policies.
- Commercial governance: Monitor spend, consumption, commitments, pricing mechanisms, indexation, credits, penalties, caps, thresholds and other contractual levers. Identify potential commercial leakage and optimization opportunities and coordinate approved actions with Finance, Procurement, product owners and vendors.
- Vendor performance: Establish and operate vendor scorecards covering service, commercial, financial, risk, innovation and stakeholder dimensions. Validate performance information, identify root causes and trends, and coordinate corrective and continuous-improvement plans.
- Governance: Design and facilitate strategic, tactical and operational governance forums with appropriate participants, decision rights, escalation paths, agendas, cadence and documented actions. Lead executive Quarterly Business Reviews and track agreed commitments through to closure.
- Sourcing and negotiations: Partner with Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Legal and other relevant functions on sourcing events, renewals and complex negotiations. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking and commercial scenario modelling and prepare decision-ready business cases for the applicable approval bodies.
- Third-party risk: Maintain a consolidated view of vendor-related risks and coordinate assessments, reporting and remediation with accountable functions such as Information Security, Data Protection, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Procurement and Business Continuity. Escalate material risks through the applicable governance channels.
- Stakeholder relationships: Act as a primary commercial and governance interface between assigned strategic vendors and internal stakeholders. Facilitate cross-functional decisions, manage escalations and translate complex commercial, performance and risk matters into clear recommendations.

Your qualifications

- Substantial relevant experience in strategic IT vendor management, technology sourcing, contract and commercial management, procurement or a comparable supplier-governance role in a complex international organization.
- Demonstrated experience managing complex and strategically important IT contracts or vendor portfolios, including commercial governance, service levels, contractual obligations, renewals, disputes and exit provisions.
- Strong commercial and contractual expertise, including negotiation, benchmarking, business-case development, cost optimization and the application of contractual value levers.
- Experience establishing and operating vendor-performance and governance frameworks, including scorecards, KPIs, SLAs, executive reviews, improvement plans and escalation processes.
- A sound understanding of third-party risk management, including supplier due diligence, information security, data protection, compliance, financial risk and operational resilience.
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a matrix organization, influence senior internal and supplier stakeholders, resolve complex escalations and facilitate decisions without relying on direct authority.
- Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to interpret commercial, financial, performance and risk information and present clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.
- Business-fluent English, required for global stakeholder and vendor engagement. German language skills are an advantage for collaborating with stakeholders based in Germany.

What we offer

Shape strategic technology partnerships that deliver measurable value, resilient services and controlled risk across Fresenius — join #futurefresenius and make an impact!

Contact

Apply now through our online portal to submit your application.
